retrieval_cues.description: What would bring this back? At most three cues the text says still resonate or would re-evoke the experience (a sensory detail, a phrase, an object), the first being the one the text returns to most. Carries v0.8.3 core.echo (first), then recall_triggers and retrieval_keys by migration. (R16 2026-10-18: short ordered list adopted; the single-string echo did no better in run 2.)
retrieval_cues.x_constraints: Short ordered list, 1-5 words per cue, at most 3 items; order carries meaning (first = the cue the text returns to most); empty list only if the text names nothing that recurs. Migration keeps the first three merged values here and preserves any further v0.8.3 values verbatim in extensions.org.emotionaldatamodel.migration.retrieval_cues_overflow.
